name: advisor
description: Get an independent read-only second opinion at a commitment boundary, before substantive work on a hard task, when stuck or changing approach, or at a final review gate. Use for "consult the advisor", "get a second opinion", "ask Claude Opus", "ask claude-opus-5-5", "ask codex", "ask opencode", or "ask a bigger model". The advisor returns guidance; the main session keeps execution and decision ownership.
